title: Order XXI Rule 90 CPC — Set aside execution sale

content.overview: An execution sale of immovable property is set aside only for material irregularity or fraud in publishing or conducting it, plus substantial injury.
content.study: Low price alone is not enough. Prove the irregularity and the injury. Deposit conditions in the rule must be met.
